kit: Vision Pro Stroke Patient Education Kit v2

assets.title: Generic educational guidewire
assets.description: Generic metallic guidewire segment with a curved atraumatic distal tip and highlighted radiopaque distal section.
assets.clinical_note: Illustrates guidewire navigation only; tip shape and dimensions are conceptual and require specialist review.

assets.title: Generic educational microcatheter
assets.description: Generic hollow microcatheter segment with a shaped distal section, transition, lumen, and distal marker band.
assets.clinical_note: Illustrates a delivery catheter at an educational level; not a product specification or sizing reference.

assets.title: Generic educational aspiration catheter
assets.description: Generic hollow large-bore aspiration catheter with crossed reinforcement and two radiopaque distal markers.
assets.clinical_note: Illustrates an aspiration pathway only; lumen, shaft construction, and marker placement require specialist review.

assets.title: Generic educational self-expanding stent retriever concept
assets.description: Generic deployed self-expanding retrieval lattice with abbreviated pusher wire, end crowns, and marker concepts.
assets.clinical_note: Conceptual deployed state only; not intended to reproduce device-vessel mechanics or a marketed implant.

assets.title: Generic educational thrombectomy device set
assets.description: Comparison layout containing the four generic thrombectomy device concepts as independently modeled components.
assets.clinical_note: Presentation grouping only; relative placement does not represent a registered procedural configuration.

nominal_visual_dimensions.guidewire: approximately 0.36 mm OD, abbreviated 200 mm distal/display segment
nominal_visual_dimensions.microcatheter: approximately 0.86 mm OD / 0.58 mm ID, abbreviated 160 mm segment
nominal_visual_dimensions.aspiration_catheter: approximately 2.1 mm OD / 1.56 mm ID, abbreviated 175 mm segment
nominal_visual_dimensions.stent_retriever: conceptual deployed 4 mm diameter x 20 mm lattice with abbreviated pusher

warnings: Generic, non-branded visual concepts; not representations of any cleared or marketed device.
Nominal dimensions are for visual plausibility only and are not specifications.
Do not use for device selection, sizing, deployment simulation, procedural training, treatment planning, navigation, or outcome prediction.
Geometry, materials, relative scale, and procedure narrative require interventional neuroradiology review before patient-facing use.
